Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Correction to $181.30
Apple Inc. (AAPL) performed of 13.28% in year to date period and weekly performance of 0.77%. The stock has been moved at 13.43% over the last six months and 23.69% throughout last twelve months. The stock has performed 2.32% around last thirty days, and changed 6.51% over the last three months.
Apple Inc. (AAPL) performed -0.91% and it registered share value at $191.7 in recent trade transaction. At present, the stock price sited at -1.29% from the 52 week high and situated at 34.81% from 52 week low. 26542025 shares traded on hands while it’s an average volume stands with 30366.72K shares. It has dividend yield of 1.52% and Payout Ratio is 24.20%.
VOLATILITY FACTOR: The stock remained 1.03% volatile in recent week and indicated 1.14% volatility in last month. The Company’s beta coefficient sits at 1.27. Beta factor measures the amount of market risk associated with market trade. Higher the beta discloses more riskiness and lower the beta lower the risk. ATR value of 2.82 measure stock volatility. The Average True Range is an exponential moving average (14-days) of the True Ranges.
PROFITABILITY RATIOS: The company’s net profit margin is 21.50%. It measures how much out of every dollar of sales a company actually keeps in earnings. Gross Margin is observed at 38.30% and Operating Margin is seen at 26.70%. Return on Assets (ROA) an indicator of how profitable a company is relative to its total assets, is 14.30%. A falling window occurred (where the bottom of the previous shadow is above the top of the current shadow). This usually implies a continuation of a bearish trend. There have been 4 falling windows in the last 50 candles–this makes the current falling window even more bearish.
Momentum Indicators
Momentum is a general term used to describe the speed at which prices move over a given time period. Generally, changes in momentum tend to lead to changes in prices. This expert shows the current values of four popular momentum indicators.
Stochastic Oscillator
One method of interpreting the Stochastic Oscillator is looking for overbought areas (above 80) and oversold areas (below 20). The Stochastic Oscillator is 82.2529. This is an overbought reading. However, a signal is not generated until the Oscillator crosses below 80 The last signal was a sell 17 period(s) ago.
Relative Strength Index (RSI)
The RSI shows overbought (above 70) and oversold (below 30) areas. The current value of the RSI is 63.57. This is not a topping or bottoming area. A buy or sell signal is generated when the RSI moves out of an overbought/oversold area. The last signal was a sell 1 period(s) ago.
Commodity Channel Index (CCI)
The CCI shows overbought (above 100) and oversold (below -100) areas. The current value of the CCI is 48. This is not a topping or bottoming area. The last signal was a sell 0 period(s) ago.
MACD
The Moving Average Convergence/Divergence indicator (MACD) gives signals when it crosses its 9 period signal line. The last signal was a buy 2 period(s) ago.
